title: Don't Trade the Inflation News Until You See This!
speaker: Ricky Gutierrez

macro_themes.view: Core PCE fell to 3.0% vs 3.3% expected, but a methodology change to three categories could account for ~20bp of the 30bp drop; he finds the timing suspicious.
October hike odds fell from ~75% to ~30-41%; strong ADP (+90K vs 73K) actually supports a hike more than a pause.

calls.condition: If MU breaks above 1,100 on earnings/guidance, expect a breakout; if it disappoints, a pullback to ~$900 would not be surprising.
calls.reason: Fair-value estimate shows 21.4% upside at a historically low ~24 P/E, but it is overbought into earnings with no margin for error; testing 1,100 resistance with 900 support.
calls.quote: if it breaks above 1,100, I can easily see a breakout

calls.reason: Closing his long (up ~$900) because the chart looks incredibly weak; prefers cash into Micron earnings.
calls.quote: I'm going to close out this trade. It's looking incredibly weak.

notes: Date: 'happy Wednesday' and the promo 'ends at the end of September. That's today' = Wed 2026-09-30 (listing approx 10-01).
